We Are Ash Way Pet Spa
Your community's go-to pet professionals are now open on Evergreen Way. With our stylist's combined experience of nearly two decades, around the clock scheduling from our website, affordable fair prices and availability 7 days a week, we make it easy for you to provide the very best for your pet. The services list will help you book exactly what your pet needs. Our Staff profile page is going to give you a feel for your provider and help you choose someone who suits your dog well. Also, don't miss our GALLERY of picture perfect pets! Thank you for supporting our small, locally owned mom and pop business!
Book an Appointment Online
-this is how it works!
Book an appointment day or night. Simply follow the link. We'll confirm the appointment by email as soon as we receive it. Thank you! Whether your dog needs a full haircut, a face, feet and fanny, a bath or a nail trim, we've got you covered! Feel free to browse our service menu in case you aren't sure what to choose. Following your booking, we will be in touch. There will be an automated reminder 2 days before your appointment. All you have to do next is text us back with the letter "C" to confirm your appointment. To reschedule or cancel, feel free to call us anytime. 425-741-2977 Thank you for your business! We value each and everyone of you more than you know.

Welcome to Our New Grooming Spa in Everett, WA!
Serving local Pets with Love Since 2007
A Fresh Start, Rooted in Care
We’re thrilled to announce the re-opening of our fully remodeled grooming spa—exclusively focused on personalized, stress-free pet grooming!
Since 2007, we’ve been part of the local pet community. We started as a small pet supply store and expanded into grooming in 2012. From the moment we gave our first bath, we knew this was where our heart was.
Today, we operate as a dedicated pet spa, blending compassion, skill, and sustainability to give every pet a calm, safe, and luxurious grooming experience.
What Makes Our Spa Different?
Every appointment is built around your pet’s comfort, safety, and unique needs. Here’s what sets us apart:
One-on-One Grooming – Every pet receives individual care with no overlap.
Express Services – Less time away from home = less stress for your pet.
Eco-Friendly Products – Safe for pets, safe for the planet.
Breed-Specific Grooming Expertise – We know the standards (and the shortcuts!) for each breed.
Senior & Anxious Pet Experience – Gentle, calm handling by experienced groomers.
Top-to-Tail Safety Focus – We use quiet tools, non-slip surfaces, and always monitor comfort levels.
Our Grooming Services
Whether your pup needs a quick spruce-up or a full makeover, we offer:
Full Grooming Packages
Bath & Brush Services
De-shedding Treatments
Specialty Breed Cuts
Nail Trims & Ear Cleaning
Dental Brushing
Senior Dog & Special Needs Appointments

All packages include professional bath, conditioning, nail trimming, ear cleaning and blow dry. The bath package also incorporates de-shedding and shaved pads if needed, but please note; there's NO HAIRCUT included. Pricing starts at $50 for small breeds under 10 pounds and goes up based on breed, coat condition, temperament and size. Large breeds are $70 per hour and standard Labrador Retrievers or Boxers take around an hour, for example. Please check with your professional at drop-off for an estimate. Extra large dogs may be $80 per hour.
